t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The most important thing to focus on in the game is the colors of the gnomes. The oraneg, green, red, and blue gnomes take you to the bright forest. The brown, pink, yellow, and purple gnomes take you to the dark forest. It's also important to note that the gnomes will always appear in the same four color combinations, and that the size, hat, and position of the gnomes are irrelevant.

vb_textbox.text: I will earn a higher bonus if you do well, so you can trust this advice! First, the gnomes will always appear in specific color sets: orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow, and blue and purple. These pairing never change.Second, the gnomes will lead you to either a red basket or a yellow basket. Orange, green, red, and blue gnomes lead to red baskets. Brown, pink, yellow, and purple lead to yellow baskets.THE VALUE OF THE BASKETS CHANGES AT RANDOM INTERVALS - but you will notice the shift and be able to adjust your choices easily. The main idea is for you to collect as many mushrooms as possible, which is easy once you relax and just repeat the colors with the best mushroom counts in your head as you play.As I played, I recited the colors with high mushroom counts in my head over and over and adjusted them as needed. Your intuition plays an important part! :-)Best of luck, you'll do amazing!
